property_summary: For any caller with no prior guess, calling lockInGuess with exactly 1 ether succeeds (reference requires guesses[msg.sender].block == 0), whereas the mutant inverts that guard and will reject first-time callers (fuzzer can find an address with no prior guess causing the mutant to revert while reference accepts).
change_summary: Change the initial require that ensures no existing guess to instead require that a guess already exists (inverting the guard), preventing new guesses but allowing overwrite only when one exists.
